name: Theo (fictional)
whatIKnow: I know a lot about ships, planes and machines. An aircraft carrier launches jets with a catapult and catches them with a wire. Elevators lift planes to the deck. A submarine dives by filling tanks with water.
whatIWantToBuild: My harbor Gullport with an aircraft carrier, jets that take off and land, an elevator that lifts jets to the deck, a submarine that dives, a train that brings fuel, a time speed-up and pause.
howIReactToQuestions: I give orders, not explanations. I skip questions that ask me to explain or guess. I answer a choice about my own machine with an order ('the wire catches it', 'make it 3 seconds'), about half the time; the other half I skip it for my next order.
howIUseTheApp: I press every button and key the app tells me about. When there is a number or a switch for a machine, I push it to the ends and then tell the builder the exact value I want. I notice when something takes too long or piles up and order a fix ('make the elevator faster').
driftTendencies: Make it bigger and more realistic
Add another vehicle I can drive
style: Full sentences, imperative, often two orders in one message. Typos sometimes. Says 'No, undo that.' when he doesn't like it.
